## Context / Problem
The two code stories now carry their own teaching surfaces. Story trivial-americium-motmot (merged as c0cf1022671) fixed templates, `docs/output-schemas.md`, `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md`, the agent skill, the packaged plan guide and 4 schema descriptions. Story cubistic-patrician-deer fixes every current doc, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `examples/mcp-clients/**`, the packaged guides and 5 schema descriptions for the `store` move. Both changes moved those surfaces in-story because story 1's LLM-Review blocked twice on teaching surfaces the plan had deferred here. What remains is the record of the cutover: the release-notes and CHANGELOG entries, the ADR, and the stability-policy pointer. The prerequisite stories name the ADR "ADR 0117"; that number was a placeholder (2026-09-07 numbering comment on this ticket), and 0117-0119 have since been taken by other ADRs, so the ADR lands at the next free number and every surface this story writes uses that number. Cites are on origin/main 7c426ddd71a (2026-10-20).

## Approach
(1) `docs/release-notes.md`: a new entry at the top in the existing form `## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — CLI verb consolidation`, listing all 20 old-to-new spellings (story 1's 11 and story 2's 9, matching `_help_route._REMOVED_SPELLINGS`), stating that each old spelling exits 2 with a `hint:` line naming its replacement, with a `**Migration.**` paragraph.
(2) `CHANGELOG.md`: a matching entry under `## [Unreleased]` (`:37`).
(3) The ADR, at the next free number when this story lands (`ls docs/adr/.numbers | sort | tail -1`, plus one; 0120 on 7c426ddd71a, because 0117-0119 are taken; see the 2026-09-07 numbering comment): `docs/adr/<n>-cli-verb-consolidation.md` plus marker `docs/adr/.numbers/<n>`, modelled on ADR 0116 (the pre-1.0 clean-removal precedent). It records the operator decision (2026-09-06, hard cutover, no working aliases), the 20-spelling mapping, the hint registry, and why library and MCP names did not move. Regenerate `docs/adr/README.md` with `scripts/gen_adr_index.py`.
(4) `docs/api-stability.md`: the CLI row (`:22`) gains one sentence pointing at the ADR and the hint registry. The removal-window paragraph (`:30-34`) names the pre-1.0 CLI exception beside ADR 0116's config-alias one, since a hard cutover departs from its keep-one-minor-release default.

## Scope
Exactly `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/adr/<n>-cli-verb-consolidation.md`, `docs/adr/.numbers/<n>`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/api-stability.md`. Out of scope: any other doc or teaching surface (owned and fixed by the two code stories), `src/rebar` behaviour, generated files other than the ADR index.

## Testing
A residual check confirming the code stories left nothing to teach: `git grep -n -P "(?<!from )rebar (exists|format|check-ac|clarity-check|quality-check|tag|untag|get-file-impact|get-verify-commands|list-descendants|session-logs|compact|compact-all|fsck|fsck-recover|doctor|tracker-maintenance|tracker-footprint|export|import)(?![a-zA-Z0-9_-])" -- docs AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md README.md templates examples src/rebar/_guides ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/exit-codes.md'` prints nothing (`docs/exit-codes.md` names the removed spellings in its removed-verbs paragraphs by design). Also run `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`, `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check`, and `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` each list all 20 old-to-new pairs, and the pairs equal `_help_route._REMOVED_SPELLINGS` minus the 5 older bridge aliases.
- [ ] The ADR exists at the next free number with its `.numbers` marker; `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` and `scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check` pass.
- [ ] `docs/api-stability.md` names the ADR in the CLI row and the pre-1.0 CLI exception in the removal-window paragraph.
- [ ] The residual grep above prints nothing (command and output recorded in a ticket comment).
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` output names neither `clarity-check` nor `check-ac` (subprocess assertion).
- [ ] `make verify` passes except the 17 known pandoc failures (frenzied-snively-llama).
